import csv,re,sys
matrix,gff,out=sys.argv[1:4]
with open(matrix,newline="") as f:
    r=csv.reader(f,delimiter="\t"); next(r)
    genes={row[0] for row in r if row}
hits={}
seen_ids=set()
with open(gff,errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line or line[0]=="#": continue
        p=line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(p)<9: continue
        attr=p[8]
        ids=set(re.findall(r"BLAG[0-9A-Za-z_.-]+",attr))
        for x in ids:
            x=x.split(":")[-1]
            seen_ids.add(x)
            if x in genes:
                hits.setdefault(x,set()).add(attr)
with open(out,"w") as f:
    f.write("metric\tvalue\tdetail\n")
    f.write("matrix_gene_count\t%d\t\n"%len(genes))
    f.write("gff_BLAG_id_count\t%d\t\n"%len(seen_ids))
    f.write("intersection_count\t%d\t\n"%len(hits))
    for g in sorted(hits)[:500]:
        f.write("match\t%s\t%s\n"%(g," | ".join(sorted(hits[g]))))

PY
